comment: GameTest-only fluid EMC values for the GT recipe EMC mapper tests (never in the jar). The fuels and oils have the Pack's values (pack kubejs/data/mcincremental_prestige/fluid_emc/fluids.json); gases GT makes from air or water are free (0); chlorine has a price. Molten red alloy is cheap on purpose (144 per 144 mB ingot, below the alloy smelter's 384), so a red alloy ingot's value shows the solidifier recipe used this explicit fluid value.
